infobox.creator: {{ItemLink|Paradinha Arsenal|image=Paradinha Arsenal Icon.svg}}While it is stated that this weapon is from Ballistics private collection, it is unclear who made the conversion. The Chassis was made by Paradinha Arsenal, however a conversion from Full Auto to Burst, as well as utilising a different ammo type, requires extensive modification to the internals, which may have been done by a third party.
